offline_packs: Existing regional archives are unchanged. Online maps and catalog points extend beyond them. Save map areas separately for expanded geography.
scope: Alabama and Georgia statewide agency catalogs, plus selected South Carolina agency catalogs; records are source-limited and not an exhaustive inventory. Adjacent coastal and offshore sources are included where documented.; Florida is partial coverage limited to FWC Northwest Region destinations and verified public data; no statewide Florida completeness claim.; Florida is partial coverage limited to FWC Northwest Region destinations and verified public data; no statewide Florida completeness claim.; Florida is partial coverage limited to FWC Northwest Region destinations and verified public data; no statewide Florida completeness claim.

sc_access.agency: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources

sc_attractors.agency: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources

nhd_destinations.note: Named Lake/Pond, Reservoir, and Estuary NHD features with mapped area of at least about five acres. NHD was retired in 2023; it does not establish current conditions, fish species, or public access.

al_destination_counties.method: County containing this destination's representative map point; a waterbody may extend into neighboring counties.
al_destination_counties.note: County refers to the representative destination point; waterbodies can cross county boundaries.

florida_nw_waterbodies.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
florida_nw_waterbodies.note: FWC regional fishing destinations and linked forecast pages; a representative point does not establish public access or a surveyed shoreline.

florida_nw_access.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
florida_nw_access.filter: Northwest counties; status Open for Business; VerificationStatus Verified; point in Census county geometry.
florida_nw_access.note: FWC status and verification do not guarantee current hours, fees, conditions, or access; confirm before travel.

florida_nw_attractors.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
florida_nw_attractors.note: NW-region reported freshwater fish-attractor sites; not current sonar, depth, or navigation data.

florida_nw_restrooms.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
florida_nw_restrooms.note: Facility-level restroom type at boat-ramp point; restroom may be nearby rather than exactly at the point.

florida_nw_species_surveys.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
florida_nw_species_surveys.filter: FWC community fish records since 2016, mapped only to existing Longleaf sport-fish profiles.
florida_nw_species_surveys.note: Survey presence is not a current population estimate, catch rate, or forecast.

florida_nw_bathymetry.agency: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
florida_nw_bathymetry.note: Sonar readings logged during FWC Long Term Monitoring vegetation-mapping operations; only Lake Jackson and Hurricane Lake are covered in this pilot. Survey date and vertical reference are not supplied consistently; not navigation.

florida_state_boundary.note: Generalized reference outline; used for display/context, not legal jurisdiction.
